title: Setup Access policy: five field helps show English in every translated locale
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmT2NE3iyG1o6TDg3sf

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #33834 dev (os-dev report 6900445592 on PR #34120), class a.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/**`, the `settings.access_policy` keys). Grade suggestion: p3 (the same residual-English copy defect #33834 is p3 for).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open access_policy help` — only #33834, which fixes the AI and audit halves and leaves these five.
Blocked-by: #33834

## 维护者速读

系统设置 → 访问策略 页面在任何非英文界面下，有 5 个字段的说明仍是英文（IP 白名单、空闲超时、会话最长时长、单用户并发会话数、强制 MFA）。#33834 修覆盖检查时发现了它们，暂时记在只减不增的 `HELP_OWED` 名单里，留给本卡。

## Facts (read on the PR #34120 head `ad576bc6`)

- `settings.access_policy` keys `allowed_ip_ranges`, `session_idle_timeout_minutes`, `session_absolute_max_hours`, `max_concurrent_sessions_per_user`, `mfa_required` carry no `help` in any of the ten translated locales, so the console's `useSettingsLabel` `fieldHelp` falls back to the English manifest description.
- PR #34120 extends `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` to require `keys.KEY.help` for every described field and lists these five in a shrink-only `HELP_OWED`.

## Ask

Add the five helps in every translated locale and empty `HELP_OWED` (the list should then be deleted or stay empty with the shrink-only pin intact). Pin: the coverage test passes with `HELP_OWED` empty; ablate one help red.

⛔ Not a claim.
